resource.category: Color grading, DCTLs, film looks, and color science
resource.description: Standalone HTML utility converting CUBE LUTs to and from PNG HALD and OBS grids. Batch ZIP conversion preserves folder structure. Run in a browser alongside Resolve; Adobe XMP conversion is a future request, not an implemented feature. Release is named Lut Converter 1.0 with tag default; reuse license is not established.
